screen.title: Announcement: Gym closed on Saturday
screen.prompt: Listen to an announcement at the sports center.

audio.text: Hello, everyone. The gym will be closed this Saturday for its monthly cleaning. It will open again on Sunday at eight a.m. The swimming pool will stay open as usual on Saturday, and the changing rooms next to it can be used. Thank you.

options: The gym will open at eight.

why.en: Detail: the gym closes for cleaning. A moves the cleaning to the pool.
why.tr: Ayrıntı: spor salonu temizlik için kapanıyor. A temizliği havuza taşıyor.

questions.stem: What is true about the swimming pool?
options: It will be open on Saturday.
It will open at eight a.m.
It will be cleaned this week.

why.en: Detail: "will stay open as usual on Saturday". C belongs to the gym.
why.tr: Ayrıntı: "Cumartesi her zamanki gibi açık". C spor salonuna ait.
